This '''mining camp''' [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|owned]] by [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] was used to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The base was attacked by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] during the invasion. The camp was [[Search for Captain Kael|protected]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]]. Sykes then contacted the [[Unidentified mine operator|mine operator]] to ask for information regarding [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] but was rebuffed. The remaining [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] fired on Sykes, who retaliated by destroying the camp.

==Characteristics==
The camp, [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|owned]] by [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], consisted of three [[plasma miner]]s, [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]], and a control room. The mine also featured a central hub which could strengthen [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]]. The area surrounding the hub had been stripped bare.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==History==
[[File:BFN_mining_camp_attack.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sykes engaging the Armored Assault Tanks.]]
This camp was in operation to [[Mining/Legends|mine]] [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> The Federation sent [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] to destroy the camp. A ship resembling the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Borvo the Hutt's freighter|Borvo's personal transport]] left the scene during the skirmish. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] was in the area at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] in a [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeder]] [[Search for Captain Kael|searching]] for his downed flight lead, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]]. Sykes received a distress call from the camp and engaged the tanks, destroying them. Upon contacting the [[Unidentified mine operator|mine operator]] to ask for information, Sykes received a hostile response. The operator's words did not deter Sykes, and after giving a final warning, the operator ordered his remaining defenses to engage the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Sykes retaliated by destroying the camp.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> At the time of its destruction, the base served as a plasma shipping site for the Trade Federation.<ref name="EG">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This mining camp appears in a mission from the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It is necessary to destroy the camp to continue during the mission, but it is not necessary to drive through the central hub and receive a shield boost. The Flash speeder is the default craft for the mission. The camp was mentioned in the [[2011]] magazine [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]] and [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] short story, "[[End Game]]."
